description: Hand-written hypothesis input (ADR-0004): attributed before/after capture pairs from the Confessor snapshots. Two chronological sessions confirmed by file mtimes: the numbered 01-10 series (2025-12-29) and the b-series (2026-01-23..25). `order` preserves that chronology: numbered series uses the after-file number (2..10), b-series uses 100 + b-number. The pipeline (er-save-editor knowledge run) verifies each transition empirically and emits claims; nothing here is trusted without the byte-level checks passing. For family tile-pickup-row-id the `flag` field carries the ItemLotParam ROW ID (the stored id), not the getItemFlagId. Pairs may override `corpus` and `save_slot` per pair; cross-check expectations and known_set anchors are scoped to the same corpus+slot. The multi_slot_differentials section verifies a flag across character slots with attributed different progression: the anchor pair pins the family base in the anchor slot, and each other slot's base is located by matching its full expected bit pattern within ±64 bytes of the anchor base (full-EF scans on 2026-07-06 showed far-away pattern matches exist but are static constants refuted by the anchor transition contrast).
